## Specific task description

Task instruction: Place large block, medium block, and small block at the table center.

Task description: The objects are the large magenta block on the left in the head view, medium cyan-blue block at the front left, and small dark-red block on the right. Bring them together at the table center and arrange by size.

Success criteria: The three blocks form a compact row at the table center, ordered large, medium, small from left to right in the head-camera view. Adjacent centers are close horizontally and nearly aligned front to back. Both grippers are open at completion.

## Execution tips

- Consider approaching from above and gripping the middle of two opposite sides of the block. Set the opening slightly wider than its width along the grasp direction to increase pad contact area and reduce the chance of hitting nearby objects.
- For rotated small blocks, fine-tune gripper orientation to their faces. Before closing, confirm the fingers are outside opposite faces and fingertips are clear of the table to avoid corner-only grasps.
- When placing beside another block, leave room to open and withdraw the fingers. Release only after the block is supported by the table to reduce shifting a neighbor or dropping the block.
